subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “Lines on paper can affect languages, families, trade, and identity.”?
options: They affect real people, and they must be questioned, protected, and improved.
Living heritage must be cared for as life, not only as design.
It looked messy, but it showed the life of the class.
A border is thin on a map, but heavy in real life.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「They affect real people, and they must be questioned, protected, and improved.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Living heritage must be cared for as life, not only as design.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「It looked messy, but it showed the life of the class.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「Lines on paper can affect languages, families, trade, and identity. A border is thin on a map, but heavy in real life.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Lines on paper can affect languages, families, trade, and identity. A border is thin on a map, but heavy in real life.」，答案為「A border is thin on a map, but heavy in real life.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「A border is thin on a map, but heavy in real life.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
